info.title: Meridian API
info.description: Multi-tenant work and knowledge API. The tenant is always resolved from the session, never from the request.

post.summary:
Inbound repository events for one project. Authenticated by the project's signing secret, not by
a session. The tenant comes from the project row, never from the request body.

expires_days.description: Days until the token expires, 1 to 365. Omit for no expiry.

scope.description: `read` (GET only) or `write` (the same reach as your session).

ApiTokenRow.description: A token as listed to its owner. The secret is never listed.

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to tell tokens apart.

Approval.description: An approval request. Columns match the `approvals` table.

challenge.description: Send this with the code to `/auth/mfa/verify`.

mfa_required.description: Present (true) when the password was right but a second factor is still needed.

token.description: Empty in cookie mode (the session lives in an HttpOnly cookie).

action_type.description: `custom` for rules with conditions and actions. The other two values are the original presets.

actions.description:
Up to five actions for `custom` rules, each `{"type": ..., "value": ...}`. Types: set_priority, set_status,
set_assignee (a member id, "me" or null), add_label, comment, notify_admins.

BacklogItem.description: One issue as the backlog, a sprint or a release scope shows it.

backlog_rank.description: Position in the project's ranking. Lower ranks come first.

BoardIssue.description: One issue as a board card shows it.

BoardLane.description: A swimlane. Its issues keep the ranking order; the client places them in status columns.

key.description: Stable key: `all`, a user id, `unassigned`, an epic id or `no-epic`.

BoardView.description: Swimlanes for the board. At most 2,000 issues are returned; `truncated` says when more matched.

BulkIssueInput.description:
Batch change for issues in one project. Each item is checked and reported; the whole batch
commits or rolls back together.

ids.description: Issue ids in this project: 1 to 100 values; duplicates are ignored.

value.description: The new status or priority, or a user id for `set_assignee`. Null clears the assignee.

error.description: Why the issue was skipped; null when it was updated.

current.description: The sprint's totals right now, read live. Not stored until the next capture.

snapshots.description: Stored days, oldest first. Days before the first capture are not shown.

today.description: The UTC day that `current` belongs to.

hours_per_week.description: Hours a week the member can give to project work. `null` when not set.

open_issues.description: Open issues assigned to the member that the caller can open.

remaining_hours.description: Remaining estimates of those issues, in hours.

utilisation_pct.description: Remaining hours as a percent of weekly capacity. `null` without a capacity.

position.description: New position. Items keep their order between neighbours, like the backlog rank.

title.description: Title of the copy. Defaults to "Copy of" the original title.

CommentHistory.description: A comment's current state and its earlier texts, oldest first.

CommentRevision.description: One earlier text of a comment, and who changed it away from that text.

change.description: `edit` when the text was replaced, `delete` when the comment was deleted.

Component.description: A component (a named group of work inside a project).

default_assignee_id.description: Assigned to issues in this component that have no assignee yet, when the component is added.

CreatedResolved.description: Issues created and issues completed on each day.

has_cycle.description: True when the dependencies form a loop. No path is reported then.

path.description: The longest chain of dependent open work, in order.

committed.description: False when nothing was written: a dry run, or a file with row problems.

new_statuses.description: Statuses the file names that the project lacks, created when `create_statuses` is set.

line.description: The file line the row starts on.

cycle_days.description: First move into an in-progress status to done, in days. Absent when the issue never started.

items.description: Completed issues by the day they were completed (control chart points).

Dependency.description: A dependency between two open issues: `from` must finish before `to` can.

DevLink.description: A commit or pull request linked to an issue.

reference.description: Commit id or pull request number.

Estimates.description: Estimates and logged time for one issue. Minutes everywhere.

logged_minutes.description: Sum of worklogs on this issue.

original_minutes.description: Replaces the original estimate. `null` clears it.

remaining_minutes.description: Replaces the remaining estimate. `null` clears it.

options.description: Allowed values for a `select` field; empty otherwise.
Replaces the select options. Refused while an issue holds a value they would remove.

FlowRow.description: Issues per status at the end of each day in the range (cumulative flow).

secret.description: Shared secret the repository host signs events with. 16 to 200 characters.

GoalProgress.description: Progress of a goal: its linked issues, and how many are done.

progress.description: Percent of linked issues done. `null` when nothing is linked; the stored goal progress applies then.

epics.description: Epics linked to the initiative that the caller can open.

epics_done.description: Of those, epics in a done status.

issue_ids.description: Epics to link. Each must be an active epic in a project the caller can edit.

IssueComment.description: A comment on an issue, newest first in the list.

edited_at.description: When the author last changed the text, or null if never edited.

parent_id.description: The comment this one replies to, if any.

component_ids.description: The complete set of components for the issue (at most 20). Empty clears them.

IssueDetail.description: Every column of an issue. Clients receive the same fields as before, now with a fixed schema.

backlog_rank.description: Position in the project's ranking; lower comes first.

purge_after.description: The last moment the issue can be restored from trash, or null.

trashed_at.description: When the issue was moved to trash, or null.

IssueHistoryEntry.description: One entry of an issue's timeline.

field.description: The field that changed, for `field` entries.

IssueLink.description: A link between two issues. `relation` is one of blocks, relates, duplicates or depends_on.

team_id.description: The owning team, or `null` to make the issue unassigned to any team.

hierarchy_level.description: 0 for standard work, 1 for epic-level work that groups children.

icon.description: One of the built-in icon names: task, bug, story, epic, feature, improvement, incident, request.

MembershipResult.description: Result of a membership change. Each id is reported; a refused one carries the reason.

reached.description: `true` marks the milestone reached today; `false` clears it.

MoveResult.description:
Result of a move: the issue under its new key, and any custom field values the target project
does not define (those are dropped, and named here so nothing disappears silently).

key.description: Optional. Derived from the label when absent.

options.description: Required for `select` (1 to 50 values); not allowed otherwise.

custom_fields.description: Values for the project's custom fields. Required fields must be present.

team_id.description: Owning team. Must exist in this workspace.

icon.description: Optional. One of the built-in icon names; defaults to `task`.

key.description: Optional. Derived from the name when absent: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

name.description: 1 to 80 characters; unique per member and project.

key.description: Optional. Derived from the name when absent: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

field.description: Required for `set_field`: a custom field of this project.

value.description: Required for `set_field`: a value the field accepts.

Notification.description: One inbox entry. Columns match the `notifications` table.

governed_by.description: The nearest restricted ancestor whose grants apply (or the page itself).

your_level.description: Your effective level on the page: 1 viewer, 2 editor, 3 admin.

minutes.description: Remaining estimate, or 60 minutes when none is set.

Person.description: A workspace member as shown for watchers.

visibility.description: `workspace` (everyone in the workspace) or `private` (explicit grants only).

wip_limit.description: Most issues the column holds before moves into it are refused, or null for no limit.

RankInput.description: Where to put an item in the ranking.

anchor_id.description: The item to place this one next to. Required for `before` and `after`; must be in the same project.

refresh_token.description: API clients send the refresh token here; browsers rely on the HttpOnly cookie.

frozen_at.description: When scope was frozen. Later additions and removals are flagged.

markdown.description: Markdown: done bugs, other done work, and scope that did not ship.

ReleaseScopeItem.description: One issue in a release's active scope.

ReleaseTotals.description: Progress of a release's active scope.

added_after_freeze.description: Issues that joined the scope after the freeze, still in scope.

removed_count.description: Issues that were ever removed from the scope.

freeze.description: `true` freezes the scope (only while planned). Once frozen it stays frozen.

move_unfinished_to.description:
Only with `status: released`. `backlog` (the default) removes unfinished work from the scope;
a release id moves it to another planned release in the same project.

status.description: `released` ships the release; `cancelled` drops it. Only a planned release can change status.

Rollup.description: Progress of an issue's subtasks, with time totals across the subtasks and the issue itself.

filters.description: Any of `status`, `priority`, `assignee_id` and `q`, with the same rules as the issue list.

stale.description: True when the view names a status, field or query term the project no longer has.

ScopeEvent.description: One entry in a release's scope history.

after_freeze.description: Whether the change happened after the scope freeze.

SearchHit.description: One search result: an issue or a page, with a short preview.

preview.description: The first 180 characters of the description or content.

Sprint.description: A sprint as stored, including its opening and closing record.

issues.description: Active issues in the sprint, in rank order.

team_id.description: Owning team. Omit for a project-level sprint that any team's unassigned work can join.

SprintIssuesInput.description: Issue ids to add to or remove from a sprint. At most 100 distinct ids.

SprintSnapshot.description: One day of a sprint's burndown.

SprintTotals.description: Totals of a sprint's active issues. Done means the issue's status is in the `done` category.

SprintUpdate.description: Fields a sprint can change. Only the fields that are present are changed.

carry_over_to.description:
Only with `state: completed`. `backlog` (the default) or the id of a planned or active sprint
with the same team, where unfinished issues go.

state.description: `active` starts a planned sprint; `completed` closes an active one.

client_secret.description: Required the first time; omit to keep the stored secret.

position.description: New column index. Other statuses shift to make room.

TimelineItem.description: One bar or marker on a project timeline. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; `progress` is 0 to 100.

TransitionAction.description:
One post-function of a rule. `set_field` writes `value` into `field`; `notify_admins` tells the
workspace admins and owners that the issue changed.

requires_admin.description: Only a workspace admin or owner may make this change.

requires_field.description: A custom field that must hold a value after the change, or null.

TrashedIssue.description: An issue in a project's trash, with the date it can no longer be restored.

Variance.description: One issue compared with its baseline due date. Positive variance means later than planned.

average_done_points.description: Mean completed points over the sprints listed. 0 when none are closed yet.

average_started_points.description: Mean committed points at start over the sprints listed.

VelocitySprint.description: Points and counts for velocity, per completed sprint.

Votes.description: Votes on an issue, and whether the caller has voted.

user_id.description: The member to add. Omit to watch the issue yourself.

events.description: Event filters such as `issue.created`, `page.*` or `*`. Empty means every event.

config.description: For time, flow and cycle widgets: `from` and `to` (YYYY-MM-DD).

data.description: The widget's data, computed now. Shape depends on the kind.

limit.description: 1 to 1000, or null to remove the limit.

Worklog.description: One worklog: time an author spent on an issue.

started_on.description: Day the work was done, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to today (UTC).

timezone.description: An IANA name such as `Europe/London`, or `UTC`.

week_start.description: First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).
